videos.title: ASML：揭開 High NA EUV 的面貌
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「奈米壓印微影」的延伸背景。辨認曝光系統的光學、載台與整合規模；動畫為導覽，不是組裝施工圖。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Nanoimprint lithography. Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
videos.before: 先問：「比較模板接觸與光學投影的資訊傳遞」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Compare information transfer by contact and projection requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「區分光固化與熱壓印的能量途徑」列為查證任務：不同機制有不同材料與熱預算。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Distinguish photocuring from thermal imprinting: Different mechanisms have different materials and thermal budgets. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 奈米壓印微影涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。 此處僅代表共通圖案化研究脈絡；Canon 奈米壓印設備的研發地點另見 Canon 官方來源，並不宣稱位於此園區。
courses.summaryEn: Nanoimprint lithography involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location. This point represents shared patterning research context only; Canon nanoimprint equipment development is described in the Canon sources and is not claimed to occur on this campus.

history.title: imec 在魯汶成立
history.text: 官方總部沿革將魯汶列為 1984 年發展的起點。
history.textEn: The official headquarters history identifies Leuven as the 1984 starting point.

history.title: 公開混合圖案化整合案例
history.text: imec 說明 SAQP 與 EUV 阻擋圖案化如何共同服務金屬層整合。這是產業研發沿革，不表示本課程全部技術於當年或此地發明。
history.textEn: imec described combining SAQP and EUV block patterning for metal-layer integration. This is research history, not a claim that every course technology was invented there or then.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
